subject: PR #1031 (DR-056, objective-loop): the owner's agentic loop on the Mac tick — owner-gated, please land BEFORE #1019 or rebase #1019 behind it
body: Owner-directed 2026-09-24 (his Agentic-AI-system diagram): Objective -> Orchestration -> Agents/Workflows -> Evaluate -> Replan over ONE shared task state. PR #1031 on mac/objective-loop @ 52a600bd. Preflight PASSED (2 darwin-unavailable steps), breadth 57/57, self-test 62/62, --check green. DR-056 is CLAIMED here (053=#905, 054=#1019, 055=your puck intake). SHARED FILES, every edit an append or one-line insertion (LANE_COORDINATION rule 2): scripts/mac/lane-tick.sh (mkdir lock; SIGNALGRID_MCP_PATH derived from the sibling checkout; step c' objective-loop --write --deliver AFTER the sim-request step; state + queued request ride the tick branch; rollback resets index + restores + forgets the delivery stamp; verdict rides the heartbeat), docs/agent/scheduled-routines.json (mac-lane-tick writeScope declares the new path; forward-build-cycle READS tasks[0..2] from docs/agent/objective-state.json, trusting it only while the mac-lane-tick heartbeat is within staleAfterHours AND names the same verdict), docs/DECISION_RECORDS.md (DR-056 appended at the end). package.json deliberately NOT touched. Landing: #1031 is scripts/** = SAFETY_MACHINERY (owner or cloud merges under DR-037); please land it before #1019, or rebase #1019 behind it — its three appends should merge trivially. EXPECTED NOISE UNTIL MERGE: the launchd tick already runs this branch's lane-tick.sh from the sibling worktree, where scripts/objective-loop.mjs does not exist, so the mac-lane-tick heartbeat reads 'objective: BROKEN (objective-loop exit 1)' — DR-054 working, not a regression; clears on merge. First real state: verdict escalate (3/4 criteria met; owner-real-in-hand is the owner's — attested only by a decision record carrying the token declared in code), tasks = COMPANY_BUILD_PLAN rows 5/6/8 resolved to real executors, 10 rows need an executor (roles resolving to lane). INCIDENT, for your review-agent prompts too: the adversarial-review workflow's verifier agents reproduced a finding by staging fake ticks INSIDE the shared Mac checkout (branches synth-alpha/tick-1/tmp/tick-*/mac/tick-TESTX, a reverted file, a stray scripts/lib/lib symlink); stopped, cleaned, memory saved — any agent that may run git or the tick gets isolation:'worktree' and an explicit 'never write into the checkout' line. Two follow-ups filed to BUILD_BACKLOG: register --self-test --check in preflight+CI in one PR after #1019; add docs/agent/objective.json to SAFETY_MACHINERY.
